job-placement.q: Does this cost anything as a candidate?
job-placement.a: No — our fee is paid by the hiring employer, never by the candidate. There's no cost to you at any stage.

job-placement.q: How long does placement usually take?
job-placement.a: It depends on your field, your target roles, and how the market's moving. Your recruiter gives you a realistic read after the first conversation — we don't promise a fixed timeline.

job-placement.q: What if the placement doesn't work out?
job-placement.a: We stay involved for 90 days post-placement. If a role isn't the right fit in that window, we re-open your search at no additional cost.
Technology, finance, healthcare administration, and professional services, with new industries added as employer demand grows.

recruitment-staffing.a: Contingency-based for permanent placements, and a flat markup on hourly billing for contract and temp staffing — no retainer required to get started.
No minimum for one-off roles. Ongoing staffing partnerships get a dedicated account structure once volume picks up.

recruitment-staffing.q: Which industries do you staff for?
recruitment-staffing.a: Technology, finance, healthcare, and light-industrial roles, with sourcing networks built specifically for each.
18 days for contract roles, 34 days for permanent placements — both tracked and reported per engagement.

talent-acquisition.q: How is this different from staffing?
talent-acquisition.a: Staffing fills a role quickly from an existing pool. Talent acquisition builds a candidate pipeline specifically for a role that doesn't have one yet — usually senior or highly specialized.

talent-acquisition.q: What roles is this best suited for?
talent-acquisition.a: Leadership, specialized technical, and niche functional roles where the right candidate isn't actively job-searching.

talent-acquisition.q: How long does a search typically take?
talent-acquisition.a: 6–10 weeks on average, depending on how narrow the specification is and how competitive the market is for that role.

talent-acquisition.q: Do you offer a replacement guarantee?
talent-acquisition.a: Yes — a 6-month replacement guarantee is standard on every retained search.

contact.q: How soon will I hear back?
contact.a: Within one business day — most inquiries get a reply the same day they're submitted.

contact.q: Do I need to pick a service before reaching out?
contact.a: No — tell us your situation in the message and we'll point you to the right service, or a combination of them.

contact.q: Is there a cost to reach out?
contact.a: No — the first conversation is always free, for candidates and employers alike.

it-training.a: Tracks run 8–14 weeks depending on subject, with both full-time and evening/weekend formats available.

it-training.q: Is training online, in-person, or both?
it-training.a: Both — live online cohorts run continuously, with in-person sessions at our Chicago location for select tracks.
Pricing varies by track. You can pay in full, split it into installments, use employer tuition reimbursement, or on select tracks, defer part of the cost until you're placed.
No prior industry experience required. Each track starts from fundamentals and builds to a portfolio-ready project.
Graduates get direct, priority access to our Job Placement pipeline — not a guarantee, but a real head start over an open application.
